description: This file defines the JobNameService class which provides methods to retrieve job information based on human-readable names within the Fineract infrastructure. It interacts with JobNameProvider instances to gather job data.

classes.name: JobNameService
classes.description: A service component that retrieves job data based on human-readable names, utilizing a collection of JobNameProvider instances.

methods.name: getJobByHumanReadableName
methods.description: Returns a JobNameData object matching the provided human-readable name, or throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: getJobNames
methods.description: Collects and returns a set of JobNameData objects from all providers.
